name: What is the process for unclogging a toilet professionally?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for unclogging a toilet professionally?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our plumbers begin by assessing the clog to determine its nature and location. We typically start with a professional-grade auger or snake to break up or retrieve the blockage. For stubborn or deeper clogs, we may use hydro-jetting, which employs high-pressure water to clear the pipe. We ensure the line is clear and test the toilet's flush before finishing.
acceptedAnswer.description: We assess the clog, then use professional augers or snakes. For severe blockages, hydro-jetting may be used. We ensure the line is clear before completing the service.
